assessment: This study by Sasson and colleagues describes the use of STORM based super-resolution microscopy techniques to examine the structural and functional properties of the blood-brain barrier associated tight junctions. The study reveals some novel findings that could have major importance for our understanding of these tight junction complexes. The role of claudin-5 at the blood-brain barrier is central to the study, and the pattern of expression and localisation of this molecule appears to shed more light on its role.
